description: This file implements a Perl module 'DiffHighlight' that provides functionality for highlighting diff outputs with color and formatting, including handling of terminal control sequences, diff hunks, and context matching.

methods.name: visible_width
methods.description: Calculates the visible width of a string excluding terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of the input string omitting a specified number of visible characters, ignoring terminal color sequences.

methods.name: handle_line
methods.description: Processes a single line of diff output, managing highlighting and diff hunks.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Outputs any queued diff hunks for highlighting and resets internal buffers.

methods.name: highlight_stdin
methods.description: Reads diff data from STDIN and applies highlighting line by line.

methods.name: color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration values from git, with fallback to default.

methods.name: show_hunk
methods.description: Highlights a pair of diff hunks, taking care of added and removed lines.

methods.name: highlight_pair
methods.description: Compares and highlights two lines of diff, determining common prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: split_line
methods.description: Splits a line into tokens based on color sequences and characters, used for diff highlighting.

methods.name: highlight_line
methods.description: Highlights a specific range within a line, applying color theme.

methods.name: is_pair_interesting
methods.description: Determines whether a pair of lines has meaningful differences worth highlighting.
